# scripts/mutation-pr.sh leaves the worker count to the .gremlins.yaml at the module root, so it passes no --workers.
# Only gremlins and timeout are stubs. The stub gremlins writes its arguments to args.
[!exec:jq] skip
[!exec:git] skip
env HOME=$WORK/home
env GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null
env GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1
chmod 755 fake/gremlins
chmod 755 fake/timeout
env PATH=$WORK/fake:$PATH

exec git init -q -b main repo
cp a.go repo/a.go
cp gomod repo/go.mod
script mutation-pr.sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh
script mutation-exec.sh repo/scripts/mutation-exec.sh
chmod 755 repo/scripts/mutation-exec.sh
exec git -C repo add a.go go.mod scripts
exec git -C repo -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m base
exec git -C repo checkout -q -b change
cp a2.go repo/a.go
exec git -C repo add a.go
exec git -C repo -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m change

# The run starts gremlins on the diff, and the arguments hold no --workers: the config file sets the count.
env GREMLINS_REPORT=$WORK/clean.json
exec sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
grep '^unleash ' args
grep ' --diff main ' args
! grep '[-][-]workers' args

-- gomod --
module example.com/r

go 1.27
-- a.go --
package a
-- a2.go --
package a

func F(x int) bool { return x > 0 }
-- fake/gremlins --
#!/bin/sh
echo "the stub gremlins started"
echo "$*" > "$WORK/args"
cp "$GREMLINS_REPORT" "$5"
-- fake/timeout --
#!/bin/sh
shift 3
exec "$@"
-- clean.json --
{"files":[{"file_name":"a.go","mutations":[{"line":3,"type":"CONDITIONALS_NEGATION","status":"KILLED"}]}]}
